subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it only render trusted structured image blocks and media-store/generated-attachment references?
rationale: The feature crosses from tool/model output into host-local file reads and terminal graphics escape output, which is a product and security-boundary decision rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Render Trusted Structured Media Only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks, generated-attachment details, or media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow Constrained Absolute Reads
options.body: Keep absolute MEDIA reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause Under The Tracker
options.body: Leave the canonical feature issue open and park or close this stale draft until a maintainer sponsors the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render Trusted Structured Media Only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks, generated-attachment details, or media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.
